items.author: Diego Fernando Martínez Rodríguez, Oct 30
items.summary: 45 reactions, 5 comments — Tableau Data Apps are now generally available in his Tableau Cloud pod. He had Claude connect to Superstore and build a "Flappy Sales" game app, with pipe height set by sales, in about 5 minutes.

items.author: David Mendez, Oct 30
items.summary: 79 reactions, 17 comments — Claude built an interactive 3D warehouse-occupancy dashboard from a data model. He argues Power BI's strength is its semantic model but its canvas is the gap, and asks whether the canvas will move to code and agents.

items.author: Paula Bobbio, Gorgias, Oct 29
items.summary: 97 reactions, 18 comments — Their internal AI agent, Cortex, made data questions instant but led to competing analyses and numbers. Her take: analysts now own the narrative and play devil's advocate.

items.author: TriEdge Investments (Salud Healthcare MSO)
items.summary: Director BI & Data Engineering — TriEdge Investments (Salud Healthcare MSO) — Remote US — posted Oct 31 — $165K–$195K — Databricks lakehouse and semantic layer, Looker, Omni or MicroStrategy, SQL, PySpark; player-coach role leaning toward engineering.
